WILMINGTON, Del., September 15, 2026 – Chase Freedom Flex cardmembers can earn 5% cash back from October 1 through December 31, 2026 on up to $1,500 in combined purchases. Cardmembers have until December 14, 2026, to activate these categories.

Chase Freedom Flex Q4 2026 rotating categories:

  • Grocery stores1: Walmart® and Target® are excluded.
  • Dining2: dining purchases.
  • American Red Cross3: eligible donations.

In addition to these rotating categories, Chase Freedom Flex cardmembers always earn 5% cash back on travel booked through Chase Travel.
